Some titles available to watch offline.Top Saturday Night Live Alumni Frequently Asked QuestionsWho was the original cast of SNL (1975)?The original cast of Saturday Night Live, known as the “Not Ready for Prime Time Players,” were Dan Aykroyd, John Belushi, Chevy Chase, Jane Curtin, Garrett Morris, Laraine Newman, and Gilda Radner.Who are the longest running SNL cast members?As of 2025, the longest-running cast member in Saturday Night Live history is Kenan Thompson, who joined the show in 2003 and has remained for more than 22 seasons. Following him is Darrell Hammond, who appeared from 1995 to 2009 across 14 seasons and later became the show’s announcer. Seth Meyers served for 13 seasons, from 2001 to 2014, notably as head writer and “Weekend Update” anchor before moving on to host Late Night with Seth Meyers. Other long-tenured cast members include Fred Armisen (2002–2013), Kate McKinnon (2012–2022), Aidy Bryant (2012–2022), and Cecily Strong (2012–2022), each serving around 10 seasons. Tim Meadows (1991–2000) and Kevin Nealon (1986–1995) both spent nine seasons on the show, while Mikey Day, who joined in 2016, continues to add to his tenure with nine or more seasons as of Season 50.How many SNL cast members have there been?As of October 2025, a total of 172 people have served as official cast members on Saturday Night Live (SNL) since its debut in 1975.Stream new movies, hit shows, exclusive Originals, live sports, WWE, news, and more.
